source: Cockpit configuration editor safe manifest; cockpit.conf(5) is comparison-only

options.help: Space-separated origins (scheme, host, optional port; wildcards are supported). Leave empty to unset. Security: restricting this incorrectly can lock out browsers or allow an untrusted origin.
options.securityRationale: Origin syntax is constrained and dangerous changes are called out.

options.help: Header whose value identifies TLS behind a trusted reverse proxy. Leave empty to unset. Security: only trust a header that outside clients cannot set.
options.securityRationale: Header names are strictly validated and proxy trust risk is explicit.

options.help: Header that identifies the real client origin behind a trusted reverse proxy. Leave empty to unset. Security: only trust a header that outside clients cannot set.
options.securityRationale: Header names are strictly validated and proxy trust risk is explicit.

options.help: Browser title for the login screen. Leave empty to unset. Security: this is displayed to users and must not contain control characters.
options.securityRationale: Displayed text is bounded and control characters are rejected.

options.help: Allow connecting to remote hosts; when unset, Cockpit detects this from the installed bridge and ssh. Security: explicitly disabling this is recommended when the service can reach private networks.
options.securityRationale: Boolean policy is bounded, automatic default behavior is preserved, and its network risk is explicit.

options.help: Require Connect to to specify a host. Security: this changes login routing.
options.securityRationale: Boolean policy is bounded and its login impact is explicit.

options.help: Allow connections to multiple hosts. Security: enable only when all hosts are trusted; connected hosts share JavaScript execution risk.
options.securityRationale: Boolean policy is bounded and its cross-host risk is explicit.

options.help: Maximum concurrent unauthenticated logins, or start:rate:full random early drop. Leave empty for the default. Security: restrictive values can deny logins.
options.securityRationale: The documented integer or ordered triple is bounded and denial-of-service impact is explicit.

options.help: Maximum concurrent HTTP connections. Range: 10–4294967295; default: 500. Security: restrictive values can deny access.
options.securityRationale: Bounded integer prevents malformed or unbounded resource settings.

options.help: Accept unencrypted HTTP connections. Security: enabling this weakens transport protection.
options.securityRationale: Boolean policy is bounded and transport risk is explicit.

options.help: Root URL path when behind a reverse proxy. Leave empty to unset. Security: a wrong path can disrupt access; /cockpit and /cockpit++ are reserved.
options.securityRationale: Only safe URL-root paths are accepted and routing impact is explicit.

options.help: Enable TLS client certificate authentication. Security: changing authentication can lock out the current session.
options.securityRationale: Boolean policy is bounded and authentication impact is explicit.

options.help: Relative URL of the top-level component after login. Leave empty to unset. Security: a wrong path can disrupt the login session.
options.securityRationale: Only relative URL paths are accepted and session impact is explicit.

options.help: Alternative login-page directory containing login.html. Leave empty to unset. Security: a wrong or untrusted path can disrupt or compromise login.
options.securityRationale: Only absolute filesystem paths are accepted and login risk is explicit.

options.help: File shown on the login page. Leave empty to unset. Security: the file contents are exposed to login users.
options.securityRationale: Only absolute filesystem paths are accepted and disclosure risk is explicit.

options.help: Idle timeout in minutes; 0 disables it. Security: larger values leave unattended sessions active longer.
options.securityRationale: Bounded integer prevents malformed timeout settings and explains session risk.

options.help: Warn before connecting to remote hosts from the Shell. Security: disabling this removes a user safety warning.
options.securityRationale: Boolean policy is bounded and user-safety impact is explicit.

options.help: Space-separated fatal log categories: criticals and/or warnings. Leave empty to unset. Security: fatal logging can affect availability.
options.securityRationale: Only documented categories are accepted and availability impact is explicit.

options.help: OAuth provider URL. Leave empty to unset. Security: changing it can redirect credentials to an untrusted provider or break login.
options.securityRationale: Only HTTP(S) URLs are accepted and provider/login risk is explicit.

options.help: OAuth error parameter name. Leave empty for the documented default. Security: changing protocol parameters can break authentication.
options.securityRationale: Parameter names use a strict token grammar and authentication impact is explicit.

options.help: OAuth access-token parameter name. Leave empty for the documented default. Security: changing protocol parameters can break or misroute authentication.
options.securityRationale: Parameter names use a strict token grammar and authentication impact is explicit.
